scope: r28 coordinate bit 28 fixed factor bases for Koblitz, general binary and prime; 2^27 x candidates per curve; same base reused m=2..9

files.submission-tool.json: exact submission identity and output URI
files.logs-tool.json: bounded logs observed during submission capture
files.results-listing.json: complete paginated results listing observed during submission capture
files.DATA_INDEX.json: byte length and SHA-256 inventory of the four captured tool responses
files.manifest.sha256: flat checksums for the four tool responses and FORMAT.json
